sections.h2: Every painting service in one place
body: Few Alachua projects involve just one surface. A home in Heritage Oaks might need a wash, new boards along a stretch of fascia, fresh body and trim color, and a re-stained back deck. A Main Street shop might need its front facade done after hours and its sales floor refreshed on a Sunday. We built our painting services in Alachua, FL so the same crew can take the whole list on. That means one timeline and one written quote naming each surface.
This page is an overview of everything we offer. For the company itself and how we work in town, see our Alachua painting contractor page.

sections.h2: Find the right service for your property
body: Most of our work in Alachua comes from three kinds of property, and the mix of services shifts with each:
bullets: Subdivision homes in Turkey Creek, Savannah Station, or Cinnamon Hills usually start with a residential repaint and add cabinets or a color consult.
Large-lot homes toward the north side of town add deck, fence, and outbuilding work, so the staining can rival the painting in scope.
Storefronts and Progress Park buildings need commercial scheduling around open hours, and sometimes concrete or masonry coatings.

sections.h2: Specialty services beyond the core list
body: Some Alachua jobs need work that falls outside a standard repaint, and our crews handle that too. Inside, that can mean patched drywall, popcorn ceilings scraped off (dustless if you prefer), or old wallpaper stripped. Outside and underfoot, it can mean stucco repair or an epoxy or polyaspartic garage floor. Decorative clients ask for limewash and Venetian plaster, and business owners can add waterproofing or anti-graffiti coatings to exterior walls. See everything on the specialty services page.

sections.h2: Ground rules that apply to any Alachua job
body: No matter which service you book, a few rules hold. Two full coats is where we start, with a third when the new color is far from the old or the surface soaks paint up. Products come from premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore lines, named right on your quote. Where a sprayed coating has to work its way into the surface, a painter follows with a brush or roller. Indoors, low-VOC paint is always an option. At the end, you sign off on a final walk, and we correct anything you flag before the job closes.

Combining services also helps the schedule. Washing happens before painting, so siding has time to dry. The deck gets stained after the railings are painted, not before, and the crew plans the order so one trade doesn't undo another's work.

If you're not sure what the property needs, book a walkthrough and let a crew lead point out what's failing. Since every service is priced on its own line, you can say yes to the pressing items today and book the others for later. If color is the open question, an Alachua color consultation is a good first step.

faqs.q: Will one quote cover painting, staining, and pressure washing at my Alachua property?
faqs.a: Yes. Each service gets its own section on the written quote, showing its surfaces, prep work, products, and coat count, so you can approve everything together or phase it over time.

faqs.q: Do you work on both houses and commercial buildings in Alachua?
faqs.a: We do. On the home side, that's interiors, exteriors, cabinets, decks, and fences. On the business side, it's offices, retail, restaurants, warehouses, churches, schools, and apartment buildings, and we can paint nights and weekends.

faqs.q: Is drywall repair included with interior painting?
faqs.a: Minor patching is part of normal prep. Bigger drywall repairs, popcorn ceiling removal, and stripping wallpaper each get their own price on the quote so you know exactly what's being done.

faqs.q: Can my family stay in the house during an interior job?
faqs.a: Yes. The crew carries and covers your furniture and paints one room before starting the next, so nearly every Alachua family stays put.
